proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C r s t hABC hcol
  have hli : ∀ a b : ℝ, a • (B -ᵥ A) + b • (C -ᵥ A) = (0 : V) → a = 0 ∧ b = 0 := by
    intro a b h
    by_contra hab
    apply hABC
    rcases not_and_or.mp hab with ha | hb
    · have hB : B -ᵥ A = (-b / a) • (C -ᵥ A) := by
        have h2 : a • (B -ᵥ A) = (-b) • (C -ᵥ A) := by
          rw [neg_smul]; exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h
        rw [div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul, ← h2, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ ha, one_smul]
      have h3 := AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair (-b / a) A C
      rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, ← hB, vsub_vadd] at h3
      have h4 := collinear_insert_of_mem_affineSpan_pair h3
      rwa [Set.insert_comm] at h4
    · have hC : C -ᵥ A = (-a / b) • (B -ᵥ A) := by
        have h2 : b • (C -ᵥ A) = (-a) • (B -ᵥ A) := by
          rw [neg_smul]; exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h
        rw [div_eq_inv_mul, mul_smul, ← h2, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hb, one_smul]
      have h3 := AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair (-a / b) A B
      rw [AffineMap.lineMap_apply, ← hC, vsub_vadd] at h3
      have h4 := collinear_insert_of_mem_affineSpan_pair h3
      rwa [Set.insert_comm, Set.pair_comm] at h4
  set D := AffineMap.lineMap B C r with hD
  set E := AffineMap.lineMap C A s with hE
  set F := AffineMap.lineMap A B t with hF
  set u : V := B -ᵥ A with hu
  set w : V := C -ᵥ A with hw
  have hCB : C -ᵥ B = w - u := (vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right C B A).symm
  have hAC : A -ᵥ C = -w := (neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev C A).symm
  have eD : D -ᵥ A = (1 - r) • u + r • w := by
    rw [hD, AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, hCB, ← hu]; module
  have eE : E -ᵥ A = (1 - s) • w := by
    rw [hE, AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, hAC, ← hw]; module
  have eF : F -ᵥ A = t • u := by
    rw [hF, AffineMap.lineMap_apply, vadd_vsub_assoc, vsub_self, add_zero]
  have eX : D -ᵥ F = (1 - r - t) • u + r • w := by
    rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right D F A, eD, eF]; module
  have eY : E -ᵥ F = (-t) • u + (1 - s) • w := by
    rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right E F A, eE, eF]; module
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := (collinear_iff_of_mem (p₀ := F) (by simp)).mp hcol
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hv D (by simp)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hv E (by simp)
  have ha' : D -ᵥ F = a • v := by rw [ha, vadd_vsub]
  have hb' : E -ᵥ F = b • v := by rw [hb, vadd_vsub]
  have h0 : (b * (1 - r - t) + a * t) • u + (b * r - a * (1 - s)) • w = (0 : V) := by
    have : b • (D -ᵥ F) - a • (E -ᵥ F) = (0 : V) := by rw [ha', hb', smul_smul, smul_smul, mul_comm, sub_self]
    rw [eX, eY] at this
    rw [← this]; module
  obtain ⟨H1, H2⟩ := hli _ _ h0
  have goal' : r * s * t + (1 - r) * (1 - s) * (1 - t) = 0 := by
    by_cases ha0 : a = 0
    · by_cases hb0 : b = 0
      · exfalso
        rw [ha0, zero_smul] at ha'
        rw [hb0, zero_smul] at hb'
        rw [eX] at ha'
        rw [eY] at hb'
        obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hli _ _ ha'
        obtain ⟨h3, -⟩ := hli _ _ hb'
        linarith
      · apply mul_left_cancel₀ hb0
        linear_combination (1 - s) * H1 + t * H2
    · apply mul_left_cancel₀ ha0
      linear_combination r * H1 - (1 - r - t) * H2
  linear_combination goal'
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P) (r s t : ℝ), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → Collinear ℝ ({AffineMap.lineMap B C r, AffineMap.lineMap C A s, AffineMap.lineMap A B t} : Set P) → r * s * t = -((1 - r) * (1 - s) * (1 - t))
